data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Script exists with executable bit, maps sections, prepends YAML front-matter
- dd-2: Leaves design-notes.md as deprecation tombstone with migration marker
- dd-3: Refuses to create DESIGN.md on greenfield without design-notes.md
- dd-5: Resulting DESIGN.md passes @google/design.md lint

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh. Pure bash, sed/awk. Accepts --target flag. Section mapping: Vision/User Archetypes/Visual Language → Overview; Anti-Patterns → Dos and Donts; others → custom sections. chmod +x.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Script exists and executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh
- [ ] RED tests from task-1 pass — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-design-notes.sh
- [ ] Greenfield guard exits 0 — Verify: TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && bash plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh --target "$TMPD" && ! test -f "$TMPD/DESIGN.md" && rm -rf "$TMPD"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
